test_title: PYST 29: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - English Language (Held On 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option:
By the time the rescue team arrived, the villagers ___ to higher ground.
solution:
The correct answer is '**had fled**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The sentence describes an action that was completed before another event in the past ("**by the time the rescue team arrived**").
 
• The correct tense for describing an action completed before another past event is the **past perfect tense**.
 
• The structure of the past perfect tense is **"had + past participle"**, which is correctly used in **Option 2: had fled**.
 
• **Options 1, 3, and 4** are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"By the time the rescue team arrived, the villagers **had fled**__ to higher ground."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "have fled"** is incorrect because the present perfect tense "have" is not appropriate for actions completed before another past event.
 
• **Option 3: "fled"** is incorrect because it is in the simple past tense and does not express completion before another past event.
 
• **Option 4: "would flee"** is incorrect because it is conditional and does not fit the context of a completed action.
